identity.name: The Club at Ibis (Ibis Golf and Country Club)
identity.hoa_name: The Club at Ibis Property Owners Association, Inc.
identity.notes: Master association (POA) at 8225 Ibis Boulevard, West Palm Beach, FL 33412, overseeing a ~1,900-acre gated community with 33 neighborhoods and ~1,800 homes. Features three Nicklaus-family golf courses and extensive club amenities. The POA manages shared infrastructure, security, and common areas; individual sub-HOAs/COAs handle neighborhood-specific matters. Contact: (561) 625-8500, www.clubatibis.com.

fees.note: POA assessment of $1,012 per quarter (billed quarterly); covers maintenance, cable, security, and capital. Exact current figures unavailable without specific neighborhood details.
One-time POA capital contribution at closing approximately $7,500-$10,000.
Neighborhood HOA fees vary widely by subdivision; examples range from roughly $200-$1,000+ monthly.

amenities.detail: Ibis Golf and Country Club with extensive club amenities
Tennis membership tier available (golf, tennis, social)
Gated community; security covered by POA assessment
